text:
pagerbot: 🚨 PagerDuty alert PD-INC-91234 fired for inference-gateway-eu1 — error_rate_5xx > 8% over 3m. Auto-escalation to multi-tier.
pagerbot: Alert details: service=inference-gateway-eu1, symptom=503/504 surge, p50 latency spike, affected_routes=/v1/generate, runbook=/runbooks/inference-gateway.md, start=2481234567
jon: acked on PD. I'm pulling metrics.
emily: I'm awake, joining. What's the customer impact? any billing-affecting things?
ash (sre-oncall): See high 5xx in eu1-rt-prod. Not global yet but traffic cutoff to eu1 is ~18% of traffic.
ash (sre-oncall): Grafana link: https://grafana/redwood/d/inf-gateway?orgId=1&var-dc=eu1 (spike at 12:02 UTC)
ash: Top error is 503 upstream-unavailable, plus a bunch of 504 timeouts.
ash: k8s events show surge in connection resets to model-pool pods.
emily: any recent deploys to eu1?
ash: No deploys in last 6h per deploy-bot. ops-bot shows autoscaler triggered scale-up attempts.
ops-bot: Autoscaler attempted 3 scale-ups in the past 8m, 2 failed due to resource quotas in eu1-prod-az3.
ash: ok quota hit in az3 is likely causing insufficient spare capacity -> proxy queuing -> 504s.
jon: trying quick mitigation: routing policy to shift 30% traffic from eu1 to eu2. Executing: `redwood route update inference-gateway --split eu1=70,eu2=30 --dry-run=false`
jon: updated routing, rolling out over 60s.
emily: Confirming traffic shift in real-time: connections to eu2 increased, error rate in eu1 trending down from 9.8% -> 4.1%
ash: Can we bump dedicated pool in eu1? quota request to cloud will take too long.
maria: Noted a number of evicted pods in eu1-az3 due to GPU resource contention. Isolated to a tenant workload that spiked alloc.
emily: Can we temporarily drain az3? `kubectl cordon node-az3-12 && kubectl drain node-az3-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` — but that may trigger more scale churn. Thoughts?
jon: prefer routing shift + soft-eviction of noisy tenant: apply a CPU limit override at the infra-enforcer level for that namespace.
ash: I'll patch enforcer to cap that job: `infractl quota set tenant-bigjob --cpu=4 --gpu=0` — on it.
ash: Patch applied, enforcer returned 200. We'll watch pod stability.
ash: 5xx in eu1 now down to 2.2% and falling. Latency back to baseline.
emily: Good. PD note: incident mitigated by traffic redistribution + tenant capping. Leaving PD incident open for 1h to validate.
pagerbot: PD incident PD-INC-91234 acknowledged by jon at 2481234570. Auto-escalation suspended.
jon: Sending customer check-in to CS: @cs-team FYI we had transient 5xx spike in eu1 affecting a subset of requests ~12:02-12:20 UTC, now mitigated. No persisted data loss.
maria: Adding runbook note: root cause suspected resource quota exhaustion in eu1-az3 triggered by unthrottled batch job. Need follow-up: tighten tenant autoscaling limits and add quota alerts.
emily: I'll schedule a post-incident review. Action items: 1) add alert for quota throttling events; 2) add automated routing fallback when 5xx > 5% for 2m; 3) modify autoscaler to prefer cross-az scale before failing.
jon: Also propose a test: simulate noisy tenant to validate enforcer caps.
ash: Agree. I'll create a ticket and tag platform and infra.
ash: PD incident remains open for now — monitoring window until 2481235170.
ops-bot: Note: cloud support ticket created for quota increase request in eu1-az3 (CS-44321).
emily: ok closing our coordination. If anything flares, PD will re-fire. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
pagerbot: PD-INC-91234 status: resolved at 2481234799 (mitigated).
jon: filing a short postmortem summary in #postmortems with links to graphs and timeline.
maria: Adding retrospective items to sprint board.
emily: Great work, team — fast mitigation.
